During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] controlled a '''gang''' that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It was led by [[Rex Geer]] in Nem'ro's stead, and was involved in battles against [[Fa'athra gang|Fa'athra's forces]] during the ongoing rivalry between Nem'ro and [[Voontara Fa'athra]].

Higher-ranking members of the gang wore blue-grey armor as uniforms.<ref name="Lean">{{TORcite|type=general|A Slight Lean|Hutta}}</ref> Lower-ranking members wore white and dark brown armor as uniforms.<ref name="Gangs">{{TORcite|type=general|Gang Warfare|Hutta}}</ref>
